subject: Vendor onboarding: banking details, PO routing & invoice channels
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@skylinesys.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding kick-off — banking + invoicing questions

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking this on. We're ready to complete Redwood's vendor setup and wanted to confirm a few items so we can align our AP flow:

- Do you prefer ACH as the default settlement method for US vendors, and is wire only used for international or expedited payments?
- What is Redwood's standard payment term (Net30/Net45)? Any early-pay discounts?
- Where should we send invoices (email address or vendor portal)? Is a PO mandatory for every invoice or only for orders above a threshold?
- Do you need a bank verification letter or is a voided check acceptable?

Attached is our completed W-9 for tax purposes (Skyline_W9.pdf). We'll also be able to provide a bank verification letter if required.

Can we schedule a short 20-minute call tomorrow to finalize the billing contact and PO workflow?

Best,
Maya Patel
Finance & Operations
Skyline Systems
attachments: Skyline_W9.pdf
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Maya Patel <maya@skylinesys.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding kick-off — banking + invoicing questions

Hi Maya — great to meet you via email. Welcome aboard and thanks for the W-9. I've copied Connor (Procurement) and Laura (Finance) to help close out the checklist. Below is the vendor onboarding checklist and our answers to your questions.

Vendor onboarding checklist (what we need from you):
- Completed Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (attached)
- W-9 (received)
- Bank verification (bank letter preferred) or voided check
- Remittance email and preferred invoice filename pattern
- Tax classification (US corp/LLC/foreign) and billing address

Quick answers:
- Payment rails: ACH is our default for US domestic vendors. Wire transfers are supported for international vendors or expedited pay (we charge a $25 processing fee for outgoing wires).
- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice receipt unless otherwise negotiated. We have limited early-pay programs (PO-driven) — let us know if you want to discuss discounts.
- Invoice submission: Preferred is invoices@redwood-inference.com with PO# in the subject line. We can also accept invoices through our AP portal (link below) — if you prefer portal uploads, we'll provision an account.
- PO requirement: A PO is required for any invoiced amount >= $5,000 or for professional services engagements. For recurring subscriptions or small purchases (< $5k), we can process without a PO but need a billing contact and contract/reference.

Next steps:
1) Please complete and return Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx and a bank verification letter if possible.
2) Once we receive those, Connor will create a vendor record and, if applicable, raise a PO.
3) Invoices should reference the PO number and include the remit-to instructions we'll confirm after bank verification.

Helpful links: AP portal: https://portal.redwood-inference.com/ap (request access if you want portal uploads). I'm also attaching the vendor form.

Thanks — we'll aim to get your vendor record active within 3 business days of receiving the bank verification.

—
Jasmine Liu
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference
attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx
From: Maya Patel <maya@skylinesys.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: billing@skylinesys.com
Date: 2026-09-15T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding kick-off — banking + invoicing questions

Thanks, Jasmine — that checklist is clear and very helpful. We've completed the Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx and attached a bank verification letter (Bank_Verification_Letter.pdf). A few notes / clarifications from our side:

- Our preferred method is ACH for US payments. For international/one-off expedited payments we can accept wires; please confirm the $25 outbound fee for wires and whether Redwood absorbs or deducts that fee.
- Our invoices use the following filename convention: Skyline_INV_{YYYYMM}_{PO#.pdf}. We'll add PO# in the subject line as requested.
- For multi-project engagements, we'll include the project code on each line item; please confirm that will map to your internal charge codes (we can add the code field to the invoice line if that helps).
- Tax classification: Skyline Systems, Inc. — C-Corp.

Attached: Bank_Verification_Letter.pdf, completed Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx

Sample bank remittance snippet (redacted):
Account holder: Skyline Systems, Inc.
Bank: First Meridian Bank
Routing (ACH): *******
Account number (ACH): XXXXXXXX
SWIFT (for wires): FMBBUS33

If you need a voided check instead, let me know and I can upload one. Also: do you have a DocuSign link or should we return the onboarding form as an attached spreadsheet?

Best,
Maya
attachments: Bank_Verification_Letter.pdf, Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx
From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, Maya Patel <maya@skylinesys.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-16T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding kick-off — banking + invoicing questions

Thanks Maya — everything looks in order from procurement. A couple of operational notes before we flip to active:

- We'll create the vendor record today and generate a vendor ID. Expect an email with the vendor ID and the PO contact person.
- On the wire fee: Redwood will not deduct the $25 wire processing fee from your payments; we can cover that for the first expedited wire for onboarding. For ongoing wires, we prefer the vendor invoice the $25 fee separately (or we can add it as a line item).
- Remittance: we will send remittance advices to billing@skylinesys.com automatically when payments go out. Please also confirm if you want remittance copies sent to a secondary address.
- DocuSign: we use DocuSign for master services agreements. For the onboarding form it's fine to return the spreadsheet as an attachment. If we need signature authority, we'll send a DocuSign envelope.

Action items:
- Maya: confirm whether you want remittance to be CC'd to ops@skylinesys.com (yes/no).
- Jasmine: will mark vendor active and route any pending PO requests to Laura for PO creation.

Connor O'Brien
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
